trained_on: vendor_risk_train.csv (2,799 rows -- the 70% train split, stratified by true risk band)
validated_on: vendor_risk_validation.csv (600 rows, held out during training)
tested_on: vendor_risk_test.csv (601 rows, touched only for this one final evaluation)
note: This artifact uses a stratified train/validation/test split of 4,000 synthetic feature rows. Its reported held-out metrics measure agreement with synthetic labels produced by app.model._synthetic_label(); they do not establish real-world supplier-risk predictive accuracy. The learning project uses this archived artifact as its fallback when no validated observed-outcome MLflow model is available.
